description: Header file defining functions, structures, and constants for RSSI monitoring in a wireless access point context.

classes.name: wld_apRssiMon_signalRange_t
classes.description: Structure representing the signal range parameters including RSSI, noise, and SNR thresholds.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_updateEnable
methods.description: Enables or updates the RSSI monitoring for a given access point.

methods.name: wld_ap_rssiEv_debug
methods.description: Debug function to output RSSI event information.

methods.name: wld_ap_rssiMonInit
methods.description: Initializes RSSI monitoring for an access point.

methods.name: wld_ap_rssiMonDestroy
methods.description: Destroys or cleans up RSSI monitoring resources for an access point.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_createStaHistory
methods.description: Creates RSSI history data for a specific associated device.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_destroyStaHistory
methods.description: Destroys RSSI history data for a specific associated device.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_updateHistoryLen
methods.description: Updates the length of the RSSI history buffer.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_cleanStaHistory
methods.description: Cleans the RSSI history for a device.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_cleanStaHistorySamples
methods.description: Cleans individual RSSI samples in the history.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_cleanStaHistoryAll
methods.description: Cleans all RSSI history data for an access point.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_getOldestStaSample
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest RSSI sample for a device.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_getStaSampleIndexed
methods.description: Retrieves a specific RSSI sample by index.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_getStaHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the RSSI history for a device given its MAC address.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_updateStaHistory
methods.description: Updates the RSSI history for a device.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_sendHistoryOnAssocEvent
methods.description: Sends RSSI history data upon device association event.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_sendHistoryOnDisassocEvent
methods.description: Sends RSSI history data upon device disassociation event.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_sendStaHistoryAll
methods.description: Sends all RSSI history data for the access point.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_clearSendEventOnAssoc
methods.description: Clears or resets the send event flag for association.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_isReadyStaHistory
methods.description: Checks if RSSI history data for a device is ready.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_updateStaHistoryAll
methods.description: Updates RSSI history for all devices associated with an access point.

methods.name: wld_apRssiMon_getMinMaxSignal
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum and maximum signal parameters for a device.
